summary.text: Victoria Wors, also known as Vicky, is the Democratic candidate for Missouri State Senate District 26 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican incumbent Ben Brown.
A semi-retired business consultant specializing in workforce development and management, she described herself in a Ballotpedia survey as a Franklin County resident.

paragraphs.text: Victoria Wors graduated from Thomas Jefferson High School and earned a graduate degree from Lindenwood University in 1998.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she is originally from Texas and has lived in Missouri for 37 years, and that she holds a Bachelor of Business Administration from the University of North Texas.

She said she worked more than 35 years for large organizations including Emerson, Coca-Cola, Schlumberger, The Earthgrains Company and Anheuser-Busch before becoming a consultant, and that she negotiated more than 80 labor agreements without a work stoppage.
Wors said she relocated to Union, Missouri, in 2019 and joined civic organizations including the Elks and the Lions Club of Washington.
She advanced unopposed from the Democratic primary on August 4, 2026, receiving 9,475 votes.
Her listed priorities include fully funding public schools, returning shop classes and skilled-trades training to high schools, and targeted business recruitment with limited tax incentives.
